\caption{\textbf{\AppTabSwitch{}. Items that the semantic groups place with questions from another questionnaire or with questions carrying another construct label.} An item crosses a questionnaire under an encoder when the core of a group it belongs to holds items from a different questionnaire, with each stand-alone question counted under the study it was taken from, and crosses a construct when that core holds items with a different construct label. Both are counted over the six encoders, and only items that cross under all six are listed, so the list does not depend on the choice of encoder. Part A lists the items grouped with another questionnaire. The eight of them that never cross a construct label are the same content taken from two sources, suicidal thoughts and behavior in the PHQ-9 and the SITBI, and tobacco use in the TUS-CPS and MVP and the PATH Study. Part B lists the items grouped with another construct while staying inside their own questionnaire, so that the groups formed from the question text combine items from different subscales of the same questionnaire. Supplementary file~\SuppItems{} gives the counts for every item, including those that never cross, the item wording where it is reprinted, and the construct labels. The questionnaire abbreviations are spelled out in Appendix~\AppGroups{}.}\label{apptab:switch}\\
